note: Shared by all of our apps: our own apps, shown in an app's ad slot when no real ad is available. Each app leaves itself out. Only list our own products. To change: edit this file, raise version by 1, put any new icon (96 x 96 PNG) in icons/, then commit and push. Apps pick up the change from their next launch. Use plain Play Store links: each app adds its own tracking tag when the banner is tapped.
